external_collaboration.evidence_quote: In coordination with hospitals, DRI supports AP-HP teams who wish to develop cooperation and exchange programs in the field of hospital care and organization. It validates cooperation agreements, interfaces and monitors with universities, other university hospitals and institutional partners. It defines and guides the strategy of reception and training of foreign hospital professionals and carries out internship agreements in connection with the staff offices of the GHU.
